business_summary: RFHIC Corporation is a South Korea-listed (KOSDAQ: 218410) maker of gallium-nitride (GaN) power amplifiers and transmit/receive modules sold into telecom base-station and defense radio-frequency systems, including radar, electronic warfare and counter-UAS platforms. Its GaN wideband amplifier catalogue is marketed directly for integration into counter-drone detection and jamming systems.

exposure_summary.narrative: RFHIC sits on two offshore-counter-drone links through the same GaN amplifier catalogue: rf-and-radar-front-end-components, the component layer one level below the radar and jammer systems anyone actually buys (QUIET, impact 45/crowdedness 30), and rf-detection-and-jamming (CROWDED, impact 30/crowdedness 78), which the chain's own role text calls its cleanest listed pure play, while also noting the occurrence itself was an explosive surface drone rather than a target RF jamming plainly defeats, a mismatch the chain states as its own finding rather than RFHIC's defect. No revenue is disclosed broken out for counter-drone versus RFHIC's larger telecom base-station business.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: no revenue percentage tied to the offshore-counter-drone exposure is sourced for RFHIC Corporation this run; RFHIC does not break out counter-drone revenue separately from its telecom and broader defense RF business. See data_gaps.

latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 185,803,786,320 KRW from the yfinance-statements statements in 218410-KQ.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (185,803,786,320/108,032,898,600)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 30,889,493,380 KRW divided by revenue 185,803,786,320 KRW, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series. Operating income was only 1,529,788,400 KRW a year earlier (FY2024), a sharp margin inflection.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 29,499,225,870 KRW divided by net income 28,656,794,170 KRW, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 29,499,225,870 KRW less capex 5,208,727,390 KRW, divided by revenue 185,803,786,320 KRW, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -44,369,272,470 KRW (total debt 65,554,470,800 less cash 109,923,743,270, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 39,113,974,380 KRW (operating income 30,889,493,380 plus depreciation 8,224,481,000, period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series. Net cash position.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 7 (state STRONG) computed over yfinance-statements statements in 218410-KQ.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 1,176,345,699,200 KRW divided by revenue 185,803,786,320 KRW for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 1,131,976,426,730 KRW implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 24,290,498,480 KRW, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over yfinance-statements statements. horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon (5y 29.88%, 7y 22.26%, 10y 16.86%). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement.
